analyst.summary: PVR Inox is India's largest multiplex chain. FY26 saw a genuine return to profitability (Rs.333 Cr net profit versus a loss the year before) with operating margins in the 29-34% range, but a large one-off other-income item flattered the most recent quarterly profit print, and reported earnings still benefit from tax-loss carryforward utilization rather than being purely organic. Return on equity remains low on a clean basis. At roughly 30-35 times earnings, we see this as fairly priced for a recovering but still low-return business, and rate it a Hold.
